choose.title: Set up the Skylight
choose.description: Provision a fresh, factory-reset lamp directly from Home Assistant, or paste the keys from a lamp you provisioned earlier with the project's provision.py.

provision.title: Provision the lamp

keys.title: Skylight mesh keys
keys.description: Paste the full contents of the `skylight-mesh.json` produced by provisioning {mac} with the project's `provision.py`. It holds the NetKey/AppKey/DevKey and the lamp's unicast address.

pick.title: Select your Skylight
pick.description: Choose the lamp to set up. If you're provisioning a fresh lamp, pick the one showing the BK_MESH_light name (a factory-reset lamp advertises as unprovisioned).

error.invalid_json: That is not valid JSON. Paste the entire skylight-mesh.json file.
error.missing_keys: The JSON is missing required mesh keys (need mac, net_key, app_key, dev_key, unicast, src, iv_index).
error.mac_mismatch: The MAC in the pasted keys does not match the discovered lamp.
error.provision_failed: Provisioning failed. Make sure the lamp is factory-reset (advertising as unprovisioned) and in Bluetooth range, then try again.

abort.no_device: No Skylight was found in Bluetooth range. Power it on, keep it close, and try again.
